name: @qf-jarvis/riya-model-interaction
description: QF Jarvis Riya model-interaction contract (RWC-P4B, ADR-0099). The Riya-specific half of the ONE structured model call: the content-minimised current-continuity projection sent as the single user message, the strict reply+observations output schema, the provenance restriction that a MODEL producer may emit only user_stated or model_inferred (and only user_stated for a CLEAR), canonical RWC-P4A observation-batch construction, and the deterministic agreement check that the model's claimed question plan matches what the P4A reducer decides. It invokes no model itself: it is a profile handed to the generic M4 adapter, so one inference produces both the reply draft material and the observations. It is ONE Riya -- nothing here is web- or WhatsApp-specific. No gateway invoker, provider, database, HTTP, Core adapter, transcript, evidence quote, contact detail, consent, canSubmit, lead, vendor, package, price or business authority. Depends on @qf-jarvis/riya-agent, @qf-jarvis/riya-conversation-continuity, @qf-jarvis/riya-conversation-evolution, @qf-jarvis/model-reply-adapter and zod.
